trial_court: Court of MS. PRABH DEEP KAUR: DJ-05, SOUTH EAST DISTRICT, SAKET COURTS, DELHI, CS DJ NO. 6574/16
case_name: Arun Kumar Gupta vs H.T. Media Ltd Ors

parties.respondent_defendant: 1. HT Media Limited (through editor and publisher), 2. Integrix India Private Limited., 3. Mr. Atul Bansal, 4. Mrs. Vidhu Bansal, 5. Brig. (Retired) N. Kumar, 6. Mr. Pavan Duggal - Advocate Delhi High Court

facts_of_case: The plaintiff joined defendant no. 2 company as a Director on 01.09.2000 and he resigned from the said post on 05.07.2005. Thereafter, plaintiff started his own company. Defendant no. 3 called company on 22.12.2005 and put the allegations of poaching the staff members of defendant no. 2 company.

legal_principles.principle: The burden lies on the party who asserts a fact to prove it.
legal_principles.held: The plaintiff has failed to give any reason, much less any cogent reason, as to why he suddenly resigned from such business for no cause.

legal_principles.principle: A party's silence or inaction can be used against them.
legal_principles.held: The reason Defendants Nos. 2 to 5 are now denying the commission of any financial irregularity by the Plaintiff is perhaps because the Plaintiff and Defendants Nos. 2 to 5 have settled their inter-se disputes upon the condition that Defendants Nos. 2 to 5 will not make any statement on the issue of financial irregularity that the Plaintiff had allegedly committed.

outcome.final_order: The suit has been settled between plaintiff and defendant no. 2 to 5 vide settlement dated 25.02.2023 and between plaintiff and defendant no. 6 vide order dated 20.03.2023.

use_for_drafting: drafting a property dispute case in Delhi High Court
resolving a civil dispute through judgment
